project.name: Aurora Cloud Platform
project.description: Cloud platform monorepo whose billing surface authenticates cost-console users and exposes plan and tier pricing catalogs through the Cost Manager API.

nodes.name: Billing Console
nodes.summary: Presents billing plans and their tiered prices to authenticated users. It owns the browser-side loading, pagination state, error handling, and table rendering for the pricing view.

businessRules: Pricing data is requested through the shared billing API client rather than embedded in the UI.
The tier view must preserve page and limit as explicit request inputs.
Protected billing content depends on a successful session check after browser reload.
crossDomainInteractions: Uses Billing Access and Session to establish authenticated browser state.
Consumes plan and tier data from Billing Catalog.

nodes.name: Billing Access and Session
nodes.summary: Handles the billing edge session check and restores authentication state after a browser reload. It validates supplied billing sessions and preserves the requested billing path, but the current missing-or-invalid-token branch does not emit a denial and can continue anonymously toward Cost Manager.

businessRules: The session contract reports authenticated as a boolean and does not expose a user object.
A browser reload must re-check the server-side billing session.
A billing request retains its original /api/v1/billing path for the downstream service.
The current missing-or-invalid-token branch is fail-open because it returns neither claims nor an explicit denial.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies authentication state to Billing Console.
Allows authenticated catalog requests to reach Billing Catalog.

nodes.name: Billing Catalog
nodes.summary: Owns read access to resource plans and flattened tier price ranges in Cost Manager. It exposes billing-prefixed routes, normalizes list inputs, delegates through domain services, and reads durable pricing data from PostgreSQL repositories.

businessRules: Tier and tier-range records are exposed as one flat Tier domain entity.
Tier listing accepts page and limit plus service-type and search filters.
The canonical and currently registered tier endpoint is GET /api/v1/billing/tiers.
Tier listing runs a COUNT query followed by a separate paginated SQL JOIN and returns the count with the page data.
Plan status is either ACTIVE or DEPRECATED, and supported service types include STORAGE, VM, and MAIL.
crossDomainInteractions: Receives billing-path requests through Billing Access and Session; current edge behavior may also pass an anonymous request.
Returns pricing data consumed by Billing Console.

nodes.name: Open Billing Pricing View
nodes.summary: Loads the Cost Console plan page, obtains plan and tier data through the shared billing client, and presents the tier table with list controls.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Open the Cost Console plan page

nodes.name: Restore Billing Session
nodes.summary: Re-establishes the browser authentication decision after application startup or F5 by calling the ACR billing session endpoint and storing only the resulting boolean state.

nodes.name: Authorize Billing Catalog Request
nodes.summary: Evaluates a billing API request in ACR and preserves the original billing catalog path. Valid sessions receive identity headers; the current missing-or-invalid-token branch can continue without claims because no denial is produced.

nodes.name: List Billing Tiers
nodes.summary: Returns a filtered, page-based list of flattened tier price ranges and the matching total through the billing-prefixed Cost Manager endpoint.

nodes.name: List Billing Plans
nodes.summary: Returns plans filtered by catalog attributes using cursor pagination, cache coordination, and a PostgreSQL fallback.

nodes.name: Mount Plan Page
nodes.summary: Starts the pricing-view workflow when the user opens the Cost Console plan page.

nodes.name: Request Catalog Data
nodes.summary: Uses the shared billing API module and fetcher to request plan and tier data from the protected API surface.

nodes.name: Render Plan Details
nodes.summary: Presents the selected plan and its related pricing context in the plan detail area.

nodes.name: Render Tier Table
nodes.summary: Displays the returned flattened tier rows and the controls used to navigate the tier list.

nodes.name: Initialize Auth Store
nodes.summary: Initializes the Cost Console authentication state during application startup.

nodes.name: Call Session Endpoint
nodes.summary: Sends the same-origin billing session request so the browser cookie can be evaluated by ACR.

nodes.name: Resolve Billing Session
nodes.summary: Handles the billing session request in ACR and verifies the server-side session material.

nodes.name: Return Authenticated Boolean
nodes.summary: Returns only the authenticated true-or-false decision and updates the browser-side auth state without returning user profile data.

nodes.name: Receive External Authorization Check
nodes.summary: Receives the gateway authorization check for the requested billing catalog path.

nodes.name: Classify Billing Path
nodes.summary: Recognizes the request as a billing flow so billing-specific verification rules apply.

nodes.name: Verify Session Context
nodes.summary: Validates the billing session and constructs the authorization decision for the protected request.

nodes.name: Preserve Original Path
nodes.summary: Allows the /api/v1/billing/tiers path to continue unchanged so Cost Manager can match its billing route group.

nodes.name: Match Billing Tier Route
nodes.summary: Matches GET /api/v1/billing/tiers to TierHandler; the direct GET /api/v1/tiers route is not registered.

nodes.name: Parse Tier List Inputs
nodes.summary: Reads page, limit, service-type, and search inputs and rejects invalid list parameters before repository access.

nodes.name: Apply Request Timeout
nodes.summary: Creates a bounded context for the tier list operation so slow downstream work does not run without a deadline.

nodes.name: Delegate to Tier Service
nodes.summary: Passes normalized pagination and filter inputs through the TierService boundary.

nodes.name: Query Flat Tier Ranges
nodes.summary: Executes a COUNT query and then a separate paginated SQL JOIN to fetch matching tier-range rows.

nodes.name: Materialize Flat Tier Entities
nodes.summary: Represents each joined price range as one flat Tier entity with both the range identifier and parent tier identifier.

nodes.name: Return Tier Page and Total
nodes.summary: Maps domain rows to the HTTP response contract and returns the requested page together with pagination metadata and the matching total.

nodes.name: Match Billing Plan Route
nodes.summary: Matches the billing-prefixed plans endpoint; the direct v1 route is not registered.

nodes.name: Parse Plan Filters and Cursor
nodes.summary: Reads catalog filters, decodes the cursor, and prepares a bounded plan list request.

nodes.name: Coordinate Plan Cache
nodes.summary: Checks local and Redis-backed cached plan data and uses singleflight coordination to suppress duplicate cache-miss work.

nodes.name: Query Plan Repository
nodes.summary: Loads the filtered cursor page from PostgreSQL when durable data is required.

nodes.name: Return Plans and Next Cursor
nodes.summary: Maps the selected plans to the API response and returns the next cursor for continued catalog navigation.

edges.description: Cost Console restores and relies on the ACR billing session before presenting protected pricing data.
Cost Console requests plan and tier pages from the Cost Manager billing catalog.
ACR authorizes the billing request and preserves its /api/v1/billing path so Cost Manager can route it to the catalog handler.
